request.title: Add Spark-ID to the Dictionary and Display It
request.description:
In the "Dictionary" panel's [Oepn Full Entry] window, -- in the "coordinates", include a mention of the "spark-id": "<uuid>", which is the identifier for the Spark that led to the project.  It is optional.  So it would say:

---
coordinates

Type: object

Repositories, paths, URLs, and document IDs.

Example:
{
  "coordinates": {
    "github": "https://github.com/LionKimbro/...",
    "spark-id": "<UUID>",
    ...
  }
}

---

If it is supplied, in the header banner (that has the title of the project, the hook for the project, the filepath for the project, and also the zookeep ID for the project,) add a GUID after the zookeep ID, like: "(spark ID: <UUID>)" with the same coloring and style as the zookeep ID's presentation.
